Subject: Re: [PATCH] FieldHash 1.04 with pure-perl support


On 25.10.2007, at 11:20, Rafael Garcia-Suarez wrote:

> On 25/10/2007, Anno Siegel  wrote:
>>
>> On 22.10.2007, at 12:12, Rafael Garcia-Suarez wrote:
>>
>>> Code freeze is near !
>>
>> I've been out of the loop a bit.  I just hope it's not too late to  
>> add
>> support for Ben Morrow's pure-perl implementation of
>> Hash::Util::Fieldhash,
>> as attached.  The only behavioral difference is that an environment
>> variable (PERL_HUF_PP) is now recognized and the pure-perl version
>> is run if it is set.  The xs-part is untouched, so no surprizes
>> expected there.
>
> So you're going to dual-life this module ?

Yes, that's the plan.

> (Don't forget all the
> patches that have come in blead until very recently then)

Thanks, I noticed.  Someone must have cursed a particular
test for needing about 10 changes for a single fix.  I'll
amend that too.

> Since in blead the XS implementation will be always used, I don't see
> a pressing need to update it there. I mean, at some point, we must
> stop patching.

I understand.  I would have been nice to start with identical versions
in blead and on CPAN, but it's right, there is no real need.

Anno
